Cream Cheese Rangoon

Reviewed October 2026 by the Panda Coupons Editorial Team • Calories, complete nutrition facts, health evaluation, and smart coupon ordering hacks.

About Panda Express Cream Cheese Rangoon

Cream Cheese Rangoon is Panda Express's signature crispy appetizer. Each order contains three hand-folded wonton wrappers stuffed with seasoned cream cheese and scallions, deep-fried to a golden crisp and served with sweet and sour sauce.

Are Panda Express Cream Cheese Rangoons Healthy?

Cream Cheese Rangoons are an appetizer treat. A 3-piece order contains 190 calories and 9 grams of total fat, with 4g of protein. While modest in total calorie count, they are primarily composed of dairy fat and refined wheat flour, offering limited dietary fiber or micronutrients.

How to Save Money on Cream Cheese Rangoons

  • Redeem Panda Rewards points:Use 150 points in the mobile app for a free small appetizer including three Cream Cheese Rangoons.
  • Take advantage of Family Feast bundles:Promotional holiday family sets frequently bundle free appetizers with large entrees and sides.

Expert Ordering & Nutrition Tips

Consume While Piping Hot

Fried wonton skins soften rapidly in takeout steam. Enjoy them fresh at the table or reheat them for 2 minutes in an air fryer at 350°F to restore crunch.

Pair with Tangy Dipping Sauce

Balance the rich creaminess of the dairy filling with sweet and sour sauce or hot chili oil to accentuate flavor contrast.
